recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片幾乎全是紅血球系前驅細胞：大型原紅血球母細胞（proerythroblast）細胞質深藍、核圓，並夾雜各階段較成熟的紅血球母細胞，部分核出現分葉、出芽或變形；紅系比例極高且具異型，但單一視野無法計算是否達純紅系白血病標準。
features: Marked predominance of erythroid precursors at different stages of maturation
Proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with round nuclei, granular chromatin and rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Dyserythropoietic nuclear changes: lobulated, budding, elongated and irregular nuclei
Relatively few granulocytic cells (occasional band/segmented neutrophils)
Background with red cells and fine granular debris
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field dominated by erythroid precursors across a spectrum of maturation, from proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei to later erythroblasts with condensed chromatin. Many erythroid cells show nuclear irregularities, including lobulation, budding and elongated forms. Granulocytic elements are sparse. Although the erythroid proliferation is striking, a differential count is needed to document >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts; in that context, the findings would be consistent with pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: MDS may show erythroid hyperplasia with dysplasia but lacks the ≥30% proerythroblasts with >80% erythroid cells required for pure erythroid leukemia.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts have fine sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and resolve with B12/folate replacement.

ddx.dx: Erythroid regeneration after chemotherapy, hemolysis or parvovirus recovery
ddx.vs: Regenerating erythroid cells are synchronous and cytologically bland without TP53 abnormalities or complex karyotype, and clinical history explains the expansion.
